# CLI reference

Every command of the `pocketone` binary with its [standard extensions](/docs/extensions/standard): PocketBase's own, the ones extensions add, and a `pocketone remote …` command for every operation of every contract, generated from it ([how](/docs/features/remote)). `pocketone <command> --help` says the same.

## Global flags

Every command takes these.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | string | – | the config file (default ./pocketone.yaml, else next to the executable) |
| `--env-file` | string | – | secrets for $VAR references in the config file (default .env beside it); never passed to the app |

## pocketone cache

Shows each extension's folder in pb\_cache and its size

```
pocketone cache
```

pb\_cache, next to pb\_data, holds files extensions can rebuild (one folder each). It's never backed up or deployed, and emptying it is always safe.

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

### pocketone cache clear

Empties pb\_cache (every extension's folder, or the ones named)

```
pocketone cache clear [extension...]
```

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

## pocketone clone

Starts a local project from a running app: makes the folder, links and signs in, and pulls its code

```
pocketone clone <url> [dir]
```

Makes dir (default: named after the app's host, e.g. pocketcon for https://pocketcon.dev), adds the app as the project's default remote, signs in (in the browser when the app offers it, else with an API token), and pulls pb\_hooks, pb\_migrations, pb\_pages, pb\_public, pb\_templates, package.json, the lockfile and patches/. pb\_data never comes. Then run `dev` in the folder to keep both sides in step.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--device` | bool | – | sign in on another device with a code (SSH, headless) |
| `--name` | string | `default` | remote name |
| `--no-browser` | bool | – | print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser |
| `--token` | string | – | use this API token (pbt\_..., a PocketHost token, or a JWT) |
| `--token-stdin` | bool | – | read the token from stdin |

From [Deploy](/docs/extensions/deploy).

```
pocketone config
```

## pocketone deploy

Deploys pb\_hooks, pb\_migrations, pb\_pages, pb\_public and packages to a remote

```
pocketone deploy [remote]
```

Deploys the project's code set (pb\_\* folders except pb\_data and pb\_cache, package.json, bun.lock(b), patches/, and the production node\_modules tree) to a remote. Only changed files are uploaded and the remote swaps them in. Hooks, pages and public files take effect by themselves; migrations and packages apply when the app restarts: pass --restart, or run 'pocketone restart' later. A deploy stops when files changed on the remote since your last deploy, pull or dev (an edit through the file drive, a migration the dashboard wrote) and lists them; --force overwrites them. A project with no record of the remote yet (a fresh checkout, CI) deploys without that check.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | – | list what would be deployed, deploy nothing |
| `-e`, `--exclude` | stringSlice | – | exclude patterns (pb\_data and pb\_cache are always excluded) |
| `--force` | bool | – | deploy even when files changed on the remote since your last deploy, pull or dev, overwriting them |
| `-i`, `--include` | stringSlice | – | add include patterns (default set: pb\_\*,pb\_\*/\*\*/\*,package.json,bun.lockb,bun.lock,patches,patches/\*\*/\*) |
| `--no-node-modules` | bool | – | don't ship node\_modules; leave the remote's alone |
| `--node-modules` | bool | – | ship the production node\_modules tree (default with a package.json) |
| `--out` | string | – | write the deploy set to a local folder instead of deploying |
| `--restart` | bool | – | restart the app after deploying when migrations or packages changed |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | bool | – | list every file |

From [Deploy](/docs/extensions/deploy).

## pocketone desktop

Commands under desktop

From [Desktop](/docs/extensions/desktop/extension).

### pocketone desktop build

Build this folder's app as a native desktop app (this platform; --all for every platform)

```
pocketone desktop build
```

Compiles the PocketOne app in the current folder into a desktop app: pb\_hooks, pb\_migrations and pb\_public are
embedded in the executable, which runs the app's server on a private 127.0.0.1 port and shows it in a native window.
Each user's data lives in their own app-data folder, named by the app id.

Without flags it builds for this machine. --all builds macOS (arm64, amd64), Windows (amd64, arm64) and Linux
(amd64, arm64); --target picks some. The apps land in dist/, macOS's as an .app and a .dmg.

With a sign section in pocketone.yaml it signs what it built afterwards, here on this machine: macOS with your
Developer ID (and notarizes), Windows with your command, Linux with GPG. --no-sign skips it.

It runs in Docker, in the build image matching this pocketone (Go and PocketOne's source, vendored, so it needs
nothing else and works offline once the image is here). --local builds with your own Go and a PocketOne checkout.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | – | build for every platform |
| `--image` | string | – | the build image (default pocketone-build:dev) |
| `--local` | bool | – | build with your own Go instead of the build image |
| `--no-sign` | bool | – | skip pocketone.yaml's desktop.sign section (builds stay signed ad hoc) |
| `--out` | string | `dist` | the folder the apps are written to |
| `-r`, `--remote` | string | – | the remote (a name or URL); default: the project's default remote |
| `--source` | string | – | a PocketOne checkout: `--local` builds against it; a development pocketone builds its image from it (default $P1\_SOURCE, else the checkout this folder is in) |
| `--target` | stringSlice | – | platforms to build, as os/arch (darwin/arm64,windows/amd64,...) |

From [Desktop](/docs/extensions/desktop/extension).

### pocketone desktop image

Build the desktop build image from a PocketOne checkout

```
pocketone desktop image
```

Builds the image desktop build runs in (Go plus this checkout's source, vendored) and tags it. A release
publishes it as ghcr.io/pocketonehq/pocketone-build:v&lt;version&gt;; a development pocketone builds pocketone-build:dev on first use.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-r`, `--remote` | string | – | the remote (a name or URL); default: the project's default remote |
| `--source` | string | – | the PocketOne checkout (default $P1\_SOURCE, else the one this folder is in) |
| `--tag` | string | `pocketone-build:dev` | the image's tag |

From [Desktop](/docs/extensions/desktop/extension).

### pocketone desktop prepare

Write the build image's vendored module into &lt;dir&gt; (the build image's Dockerfile runs this)

```
pocketone desktop prepare <dir>
```

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-r`, `--remote` | string | – | the remote (a name or URL); default: the project's default remote |
| `--source` | string | – | the PocketOne source tree |

From [Desktop](/docs/extensions/desktop/extension).

## pocketone dev

Keeps the project's code and a remote in step both ways (and streams the remote's logs)

```
pocketone dev [remote]
```

Syncs pb\_hooks, pb\_migrations, pb\_pages, pb\_public and the other pb\_\* folders, package.json, bun.lock(b) and patches/ both ways: edits here are uploaded half a second after you save, and changes on the remote (such as migrations the dashboard writes) are downloaded within seconds. node\_modules is only uploaded, when package.json or the lockfile changes. pb\_data is never synced. Hooks, pages and public files take effect by themselves; migrations and packages you upload apply when the app restarts: type r and Enter. State is kept in .pocketone/; files to leave out go in .pocketoneignore.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-e`, `--exclude` | stringSlice | – | exclude patterns (pb\_data and pb\_cache are always excluded) |
| `-i`, `--include` | stringSlice | – | add include patterns (default set: pb\_\*,pb\_\*/\*\*/\*,package.json,bun.lockb,bun.lock,patches,patches/\*\*/\*) |
| `--no-logs` | bool | – | don't stream the remote's logs |
| `--no-node-modules` | bool | – | don't ship node\_modules; leave the remote's alone |
| `--node-modules` | bool | – | ship the production node\_modules tree (default with a package.json) |
| `--poll` | duration | `5s` | how often to check the remote for changes |
| `--prefer` | string | – | on the first sync, files that differ: local (upload yours) or remote (download theirs); default asks |
| `--push-only` | bool | – | only upload changes (the old one-way dev); never download |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | bool | – | list every file |

From [Deploy](/docs/extensions/deploy).

## pocketone extensions

Manages the extensions' own schema (their migrations)

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

### pocketone extensions migrate

Applies or reverts an extension's migrations

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

### pocketone extensions migrate down

Reverts an extension's last n migrations (default 1; 0: all of them)

```
pocketone extensions migrate down <extension> [n]
```

Reverting drops what the migrations created, data included. The next start applies them again, unless the extension is turned off (`&lt;extension&gt;: {enabled: false}` in pocketone.yaml).

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

### pocketone extensions migrate up

Applies pending extension migrations (startup does this too)

```
pocketone extensions migrate up [extension]
```

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

### pocketone extensions migrations

Lists each extension's migrations and whether they're applied

```
pocketone extensions migrations
```

Extensions apply their migrations at startup, after PocketBase's own and before the app's pb\_migrations, and record them in \_extension\_migrations (apart from the app's \_migrations).

From [Standard Set](/docs/extensions/standard).

## pocketone migrate

Executes app DB migration scripts

```
pocketone migrate
```

Supported arguments are:
- up            - runs all available migrations
- down [number] - reverts the last [number] applied migrations
- create name   - creates new blank migration template file
- collections   - creates new migration file with snapshot of the local collections configuration
- history-sync  - ensures that the \_migrations history table doesn't have references to deleted migration files


| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dev` | bool | – | enable dev mode, aka. printing logs and sql statements to the console |
| `--dir` | string | `<the binary's folder>/pb_data` | the PocketBase data directory |
| `--encryptionEnv` | string | – | the env variable whose value of 32 characters will be used as encryption key for the app settings (default none) |
| `--hooksDir` | string | – | the directory with the JS app hooks |
| `--hooksPool` | int | `15` | only with `--jsvm` goja: the JS runtimes kept ready for hooks |
| `--jsvm` | string | `quickjs` | the JS engine: quickjs (PocketOne's) or goja (PocketBase's own, for pure PocketBase compatibility) |
| `--migrationsDir` | string | – | the directory with the user defined migrations |
| `--queryTimeout` | int | `30` | the default SELECT queries timeout in seconds |

From PocketBase.

## pocketone pitr

Point-in-time restore of the database

From [PITR](/docs/extensions/pitr).

Every `pocketone pitr` command takes these.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dev` | bool | – | enable dev mode, aka. printing logs and sql statements to the console |
| `--dir` | string | `<the binary's folder>/pb_data` | the PocketBase data directory |
| `--encryptionEnv` | string | – | the env variable whose value of 32 characters will be used as encryption key for the app settings (default none) |
| `--hooksDir` | string | – | the directory with the JS app hooks |
| `--hooksPool` | int | `15` | only with `--jsvm` goja: the JS runtimes kept ready for hooks |
| `--jsvm` | string | `quickjs` | the JS engine: quickjs (PocketOne's) or goja (PocketBase's own, for pure PocketBase compatibility) |
| `--migrationsDir` | string | – | the directory with the user defined migrations |
| `--queryTimeout` | int | `30` | the default SELECT queries timeout in seconds |

### pocketone pitr restore

Restore the database as it was at --at, into --to, or in place on the next start

```
pocketone pitr restore
```

With --to, writes the database as it was at --at into that file (any time, also on a fresh machine with the same bucket config). Without --to, stages the restore in place; run it while the server is stopped: the swap happens on the next start.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--at` | string | – | time to restore to (RFC 3339) |
| `--to` | string | – | write into this file instead of restoring in place |

From [PITR](/docs/extensions/pitr).

### pocketone pitr status

Show the restorable window and history size

```
pocketone pitr status
```

From [PITR](/docs/extensions/pitr).

### pocketone remote api-tokens

Commands under remote api-tokens

### pocketone remote api-tokens verify

Checks an API token and says who it acts as and what it may do (its scopes, with their values) (api-tokens.verify/v1)

```
pocketone remote api-tokens verify
```

Checks an API token and says who it acts as and what it may do (its scopes, with their values). A token that isn't valid is an answer (Valid false), not an error, so callers can tell a refused token from an outage.

Calls POST /api/\_c/api-tokens.verify/v1/ on the remote (token scope: api\_tokens\_verify).

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ip` | string | – |  |
| `--json` | string | – | the whole input as JSON (@file reads a file, - reads stdin); flags override its fields |
| `-r`, `--remote` | string | – | the remote (a name or URL); default: the project's default remote |
| `--token` | string | – |  |

From [api-tokens.verify/v1](/docs/contracts/api-tokens.verify/v1) (generated).

### pocketone remote instance watch

### pocketone remote instance watch stream

Opens this edge's stream: a hello first, then answers and changes for the hostnames it watches, the edges list when it changes, and its standing set when that changes (instance.watch/v1)

```
pocketone remote instance watch stream
```

## pocketone serve

Starts the web server (default to 127.0.0.1:8090 if no domain is specified)

```
pocketone serve [domain(s)]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--automigrate` | bool | `true` | enable/disable auto migrations |
| `--autotls` | bool | – | HTTPS certificates through CertMagic instead of the built-in autocert (with serve &lt;domain&gt; or `--https`): other CAs, extra domains, wildcards through DNS-01 |
| `--autotlsCA` | string | – | certificate authority for `--autotls`: letsencrypt (default), letsencrypt-staging, zerossl, or an ACME directory URL |
| `--autotlsDNS` | string | – | DNS provider for DNS-01 challenges with `--autotls` (supported: cloudflare) |
| `--autotlsDNSTokenEnv` | string | `CF_API_TOKEN` | environment variable holding the DNS provider's API token for `--autotlsDNS` |
| `--autotlsDomains` | stringSlice | – | extra domains for `--autotls`, obtained at start (comma separated; wildcards like \*.example.com need `--autotlsDNS`) |
| `--autotlsEmail` | string | – | ACME account email for `--autotls` (expiry notices from the CA) |
| `--dev` | bool | – | enable dev mode, aka. printing logs and sql statements to the console |
| `--dir` | string | `<the binary's folder>/pb_data` | the PocketBase data directory |
| `--encryptionEnv` | string | – | the env variable whose value of 32 characters will be used as encryption key for the app settings (default none) |
| `--hooksDir` | string | – | the directory with the JS app hooks |
| `--hooksPool` | int | `15` | only with `--jsvm` goja: the JS runtimes kept ready for hooks |
| `--hooksWatch` | bool | `true` | auto restart the app on pb\_hooks file change; it has no effect on Windows |
| `--http` | string | – | TCP address to listen for the HTTP server (if domain args are specified - default to 0.0.0.0:80, otherwise - default to 127.0.0.1:8090) |
| `--https` | string | – | TCP address to listen for the HTTPS server (if domain args are specified - default to 0.0.0.0:443, otherwise - default to empty string, aka. no TLS) The incoming HTTP traffic also will be auto redirected to the HTTPS version |
| `--indexFallback` | bool | `true` | fallback the request to index.html on missing static path, e.g. when pretty urls are used with SPA |
| `--jsvm` | string | `quickjs` | the JS engine: quickjs (PocketOne's) or goja (PocketBase's own, for pure PocketBase compatibility) |
| `--migrationsDir` | string | – | the directory with the user defined migrations |
| `--origins` | stringSlice | `[*]` | CORS allowed domain origins list |
| `--pagesDir` | string | – | the directory with the app's pages (default pb\_pages next to pb\_data); served when it exists |
| `--pitr` | bool | `true` | point-in-time restore: replicate data.db into pb\_data/litestream/ while serving |
| `--pitrRetention` | duration | `72h0m0s` | how far back a point-in-time restore can go |
| `--publicDir` | string | `<the binary's folder>/pb_public` | the directory to serve static files |
| `--queryTimeout` | int | `30` | the default SELECT queries timeout in seconds |
| `--s3Redirect` | bool | `true` | answer file downloads with a short-lived signed redirect to the bucket when S3 file storage is on |
| `--s3RedirectTTL` | duration | `5m0s` | how long each signed file download URL stays valid |

From PocketBase.

### pocketone template eject

Copies a template set (every set without a name) into pb\_templates/&lt;set&gt;/ for you to edit

```
pocketone template eject [set]
```

Copies the set's built-in Go templates into pb\_templates/&lt;set&gt;/; the app renders your copy of each file from then on (delete a file to go back to the built-in one). Files you already have and haven't changed are left alone; files you changed are only overwritten after you confirm, or with --force.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | bool | – | overwrite files you changed without asking |

From [Templates](/docs/extensions/templates).

```

```

## pocketone upgrade

Upgrades this executable to the latest release, keeping the old one as &lt;name&gt;-&lt;version&gt;

```
pocketone upgrade
```

Upgrades this executable to the latest release, keeping the old one as &lt;name&gt;-&lt;version&gt;.

The newest release is offered, prereleases included. Moving from a stable release to a prerelease asks first
(no means the newest stable release instead, if there's a newer one); from one prerelease to the next it doesn't.

| Flag | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--backup` | bool | `true` | Back up pb\_data after upgrading, if this folder has one |
| `-y`, `--yes` | bool | – | Move from a stable release to a prerelease without asking |

From [Upgrade](/docs/extensions/upgrade).
